title: ever DAKOTA|Double V-Neck Waist Trimmed Chiffon Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant chiffon mother of the bride dress features a flattering double V-neck and waist trimming that enhances your shape. The soft, flowing fabric creates a graceful silhouette, making it perfect for any formal event. Simple yet sophisticated, this dress offers timeless style and comfort.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
